trim_order_lifetime.rule: A position-limit trim lasts for only the immediately following session. After that session's fills and closing mark, discard any unfilled trim remainder and recompute the smallest whole100-share trim from the latest closing position. If current marked value is at most1000CNY, cancel the remainder; do not continue an obsolete trim.
trim_order_lifetime.formula: At close t: trim_shares = min(position_shares,100*ceil(max(position_shares*close_t-1000,0)/(100*close_t))). It is a request for session t+1 and cannot affect t.
trim_order_lifetime.example: 300shares at3.36queue100for tomorrow. If tomorrow is unfilled and closes3.32, marked value996cancels that trim; no daily-loss trigger is assumed in this example.
trim_order_lifetime.mandatory_exits: Account-stop and scheduled/252-session exits persist until flat or fixed study terminal. A later price drop never cancels them. Mandatory exit supersedes any trim; only one outgoing order per asset/session.

volume_capacity.advance_order_limit: Prior capacity only; current capacity cannot increase or resize the advance order. Current full-day volume is a retrospective modeled-fill bound, not information available before the order or evidence of closing-auction depth.
volume_capacity.buy_rule: Prior-information entry quantity is a multiple of100, limited by prior capacity and all-in1000CNYbudget. Fill the entire predeclared quantity only if it is no larger than current capacity and remains within budget/cash at the modeled price. Otherwise cancel the whole entry; no partial buys or retries.
volume_capacity.sell_rule: Choose advance requested quantity from persistent liquidation or latest trim, capped by prior capacity. Modeled sale quantity =100*floor(min(requested_shares,prior_capacity_shares,current_capacity_shares)/100). Charge one fee for each nonzero modeled partial fill. Carry a mandatory-exit remainder; refresh/cancel a trim remainder after the new close.
volume_capacity.odd_lot_exception: Only a full liquidation of the entire remaining integer-share position may include its below100-share remainder, and only when the complete remaining quantity fits requested,priorcapacity,currentcapacity. Never create an arbitrary odd partial sell. Current reviewed assets have no in-window split that generates odd lots; unsupported corporate actions fail input acceptance.
volume_capacity.example: A requested sale200shares,priorcapacity>=200,currentvolume10000shares,can fill100shares. A requested buy200under the same limits cancels entirely.
